notes.title: Info
notes.content:
Hello friends!
I haven't written anything for a long time, and this is wrong, because I haven't abandoned the project.
The update will be coming soon!
From the new what is done:
[b]- Zombies now have random animations of running, walking;[/b]
[b]- 3 new cards at the final stage;[/b]
[b]- Added a turret with a minigun and a flamethrower;[/b]
[b]- 5 types of weapons, close combat with a knife, C4/grenades;[/b]
[b]- Updated menu design and added unique background music so that it would not be boring to wait for friends in the lobby);[/b]
[b]- The long-awaited flashlight;[/b]
[b]- and many more little things.[/b]
I hope to finish soon and release an update =)
p.s. I apologize for my English ^^

notes.title: So by the way
notes.content: I got so carried away that it will be a different game with everything =) Yes, it's still a Zombie defense, but improved at times. I hope I'll finish soon, but it's not going very fast, unfortunately

notes.title: A new map.
notes.content:
One of the new maps is almost ready. A military checkpoint in the forest is great for playing in company. 4 separate entrances will allow each player to be involved in the battle with hordes of zombies. Which by the way will become smarter and more cunning =)

notes.title: Development progress stories
notes.content: Hi guys, the group is growing every day, and the question arose where is it more convenient for you to monitor the progress of development? Steam Public is not a particularly popular place for this, so I am ready to listen to your suggestions.

notes.title: Project development
notes.content:
Hi friends, since the release I haven’t been in touch and haven’t posted anything. I decided to tell a little about what is being worked on and when there will be updates.
And so, a major summer sale is coming and in connection with this, no major updates are expected, but immediately after it ends, the first major update will be released that will radically change the game!
[b]1. Of course the first building system:[/b]
  It will be possible to build simple barriers that should keep zombies, as well as traps for the quick destruction of especially dangerous waves.
[b]2. Purchase and installation of turrets[/b], I think that the game process was not boring, introduce the need to care for them, as well as the need to bring ammunition.
[b]3. Maps[/b], new and most likely old will be removed (not sure yet), and all because of the limited space, there is no place to build whatever you want. The cards will not be related to each other in any way, and therefore they will be both retro and possibly something on the space)
[b]4. Character animations, behavior, etc.[/b] of course will be finalized
[b]5. New types of weapons.[/b]
In conclusion, I will say that the plans are of course big and the changes will be appropriate. I hope you will follow the progress of this project and support it.
Thank you all, love you all <3
